tools.name: context_pack
tools.title: Build Kyro context pack
tools.description: Return the minimal routing/task context an agent should load for a Kyro scope. Use before resuming work or executing a task.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

task_id.description: Optional active sprint task id. Empty string means handoff.nextTaskId.

tools.name: doctor_artifacts
tools.title: Run Kyro artifact doctor
tools.description: Validate Kyro project and scope artifact shape, snapshots, narratives, and clarity markers. Use to check a scope is well-formed before planning or closing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

tools.name: analyze_scope
tools.title: Analyze Kyro scope semantics
tools.description: Run semantic cross-checks for clarity, coverage, dependencies, debt, spec traceability, and project principles. Use to find blocking findings before executing or closing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

tools.name: scope_list
tools.title: List Kyro scopes
tools.description: List known Kyro scopes, their status, and which one is active. Use to discover scopes before targeting one.

tools.name: scope_inspect
tools.title: Inspect Kyro scope
tools.description: Return artifact doctor checks for one scope. Use to inspect a single scope by id.

tools.name: close_sprint
tools.title: Close active Kyro sprint
tools.description: Build or apply the deterministic zero-loss close-sprint plan. Use when every sprint task passed review and the sprint is ready to close. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: repair_scope
tools.title: Repair Kyro scope formatting
tools.description: Build or apply a sprint.json normalization plan. Use when doctor reports formatting drift. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: review_task
tools.title: Review a Kyro task (maker/checker)
tools.description: Run the deterministic maker/checker on a task and write its verdict. Use when a task is done and needs verification. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing; a pass that fails the deterministic checks is refused.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

checked_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria the reviewer checked. Defaults to all on a pass.

waived_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria waived as "criterion::reason". Reason is required.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: trace_tail
tools.title: Read recent Kyro trace events
tools.description: Return the most recent append-only trace events for a scope. Use for observability or debugging a run. Read-only; trace never drives routing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

limit.description: Max events to return (most recent). Defaults to 20.
